capabilities: sync recipes from a Cooksync account into the vault
include recipe data, source, and cover image
automatically add tags to imported recipes
run auto-sync or trigger manual sync via command
extras: The plugin is useless without a paid Cooksync subscription; the README states it "requires a Cooksync account — a paid service".
problem: Getting recipes saved from recipe websites into Obsidian notes normally requires manual copying and formatting.
summary: Cooksync account connector that automatically imports recipes collected through the Cooksync service into an Obsidian vault.
